payload.title: Cutover: delete TS backend, docs overhaul, release v0.4.0
payload.description: Once conformance + SDK acceptance are green: delete apps/server, packages/protocol, apps/cli (TS), packages/mcp, packages/agent-kit, and the TS codegen pipeline; rewrite README, docs/onboarding.md, docs/authoring.md, docs/operations.md, docs/schema-author-tutorial.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, AGENTS.md for the Rust stack; update Tiltfile/docker/ops; CHANGELOG + publish checklist; ship v0.3.x → v0.4.0. Web/Swift/Kotlin clients and generated TS remain.
